Idents(all_merged_harmony_cluster_v2_PrepSCT_12sample_old_res0.5) <- "Trans_MD_cell"
sub <- subset(all_merged_harmony_cluster_v2_PrepSCT_12sample_old_res0.5, idents = c("Mesenchymal cells-1", "Mesenchymal cells-2", "Mesenchymal cells-3", 
                                             "Perivascular cells", "Trans_tdTomatoH", "MD"))
sub@active.ident <- factor(sub@active.ident, 
                           levels = c("MD", "Trans_tdTomatoH", "Mesenchymal cells-1", "Mesenchymal cells-2", "Mesenchymal cells-3", "Perivascular cells"))
DimPlot(sub, reduction = "umap", label = F, raster = F) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("MD" = "#F8766D", 
                                "Trans_tdTomatoH" = "#FF61CC", 
                                "Mesenchymal cells-1" = "#00BFC4", 
                                "Mesenchymal cells-2" = "#CD9600", 
                                "Mesenchymal cells-3" = "#7CAE00", 
                                "Perivascular cells" = "#C77CFF"),
                     labels = c("MD" = "MD epi", 
                                "Trans_tdTomatoH" = "MD trans", 
                                "Mesenchymal cells-1" = "Mes1", 
                                "Mesenchymal cells-2" = "Mes2", 
                                "Mesenchymal cells-3" = "Mes3", 
                                "Perivascular cells" = "Peri")) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 6))) + # Increase size (default is 3)
  theme(
    axis.line = element_blank(),  # Remove axis lines
    axis.text = element_blank(),  # Remove axis text
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),     # Remove x-axis title
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),     # Remove y-axis title# Remove axis ticks
    #legend.position = "none",  # Remove the legend
    plot.title = element_blank(),  # Remove the title
  )
